2.2 25-1345 Final Adoption of Ordinances.
(a) Ordinance No. 31279 - An Ordinance of the City of San Jose Rezoning Certain Real Property of Approximately 1.88 Gross Acres, Situated South of the Eastern Terminus of Bern Court (908 Bern Court) (APN: 241-15-009) from the LI(PD) Planned Development Zoning District to the CIC Combined Industrial/Commercial Zoning District.

Action: Ordinance No. 31279 ... was adopted. (11-0-0)
